name: photo-pigeon-app
//: No version field, on purpose. Lockstep versioning: the repo root package.json holds the one number written by hand. tauri.conf.json reads it as "../../package.json", and app/src-tauri/build.rs fails the build when Cargo.toml disagrees with it. This package is private and never published, so a version here would only be a fourth number able to lie, which it already did once: M0 set it to 9.9.9 and the bundler still emitted photo-pigeon_0.1.0_x64-setup.exe.
description: Tauri 2 tray shell for photo-pigeon. Nothing here reaches npm: the published package is the repo root, whose files field is dist, README.md and LICENSE.

scripts.//predev: predev and prebuild stage the sidecar before anything can read it, so npm run dev and npm run build can never ship yesterday's core. CI job 3 calls tauri-action directly rather than through npm, so it must run node scripts/build-sidecar.mjs as its own step.
